about.title: About Esen & Mouchammed · Photographers in Den Bosch
about.description: Meet Esen & Mouchammed, the husband-and-wife photographers behind Esen Photography in Den Bosch. Our story, our approach and what makes a photo you can feel.
story: We're Esen & Mouchammed, the husband-and-wife team behind Esen Photography. Our story started over ten years ago in our university's photography club, where we met and bonded over our love for taking pictures. What began as a shared hobby turned into a life together, both as partners and as photographers.

We decided to make photography our job. From our early, shaky photos to the clear, meaningful ones we take now, we've grown together, learning and having fun along the way. We've built a business that's about more than pictures: it's about connecting with people and saving special moments.

As a team, we bring creativity and care to every shoot. Whether we're making a newborn smile, capturing a bride's big day or finding the best light for a fashion shot, we put our all into every photo. We've learned that the best pictures are the ones you can feel.
We'd love to share our passion with you and help tell your story through our cameras.
